name: ha-ask-worker
description: Hawaiʻi Appleseed public Q&A assistant: Cloudflare Worker backend

scripts.deploy: npm run index && npm run widget && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:public: npm run index:public && python3 ../build_embed.py --worker-module src/widget.js --out ../dist/embed.html && wrangler deploy
scripts.widget: python3 ../build_embed.py --endpoint /chat --worker-module src/widget.js --out ../dist/embed-internal.html --notice "Staff pilot: this assistant's policy positions are drafts that staff have not approved yet. Please do not quote its answers outside the organization, and tell the policy team about anything that looks wrong."
